chunks: I will offer them the edge of the sword, which is enough a curer of wrong and supporter of Right.
It is strange they send me word to proceed to them for spear-fighting!
And to keep ready for fighting with swords.
May the mourning women mourn over them.
I have ever been so that I was never frightened by fighting nor threatened by clashing.
I enjoy full certainty of belief from my Allāh and have no doubt in my faith.
ai.seo_question: What is Imam Ali's response to his accusers regarding the sword and his certainty in faith?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) frames the impending conflict not merely as a political dispute but as a cosmic struggle between truth and falsehood, asserting that the sword serves as a decisive validator of his claim. He highlights the irony of his opponents sending him a declaration of war, emphasizing his personal readiness and unwavering certainty (yaqin) in his divine mandate. This passage underscores the Shia scholarly view that his rule was established by right, making the subsequent battles a defense of that legitimate authority rather than a power grab.
